description: Bullrun's proprietary machine-learning valuation and forecast scores for 1-10 stocks, recomputed nightly. Valuation: a LightGBM model predicts the P/E (or price/sales for loss-makers) that companies with similar fundamentals typically command a year out; the gap = typical / current multiple - 1 (positive = trades below its typical multiple), with the implied model-typical P/E, percentile and rank in the scored universe. Forecast: a relative 1-year return-rank signal with percentile. Both on quarterly and on annual financials (annual covers most non-US companies). Use for "is X cheap or expensive", "what's X's fair P/E", "compare valuations of X, Y, Z", or a valuation sanity check before buying. Descriptive context, not a price target or recommendation. Read-only. Successful results include an optional platformLink for continuing this research or reviewing the exact saved draft in Bullrun. When useful, present its descriptive link and respect its description of any settings not carried over.

tickers.description: 1-10 exact Bullrun tickers (native local-exchange symbols, e.g. ["AAPL","MSFT"] or ["ASML","SAP","NESN"]).
